scope: Source-only review of all six candidate-v1 preview frames. Bronze hardware is placeholder context and excluded from replacement judgment. Door preview uses a layered shader; staged standard-Lit composited per-leaf mapping has not been rendered or accepted in this review.
improvements: The quieter painted coating and fine scratches are a stronger material direction than native03's broad, soft orange corrosion islands.
Opposed soft light moves the specular response and reads the slat and door depth without a uniform shiny color highlight remaining in the albedo view.
Large areas of intact dark paint are useful and should be retained.

remainingBlockers.issue: An identifiable diagonal smear and bright scratch cluster repeat across Finery door leaves and through the shutter rows. The regular low-frequency banding makes the material feel tiled.
remainingBlockers.evidence: Visible in albedo and both lighting directions. The recipe records a translation-only quilt repeating at0.8 by1m, consistent with the observed rhythm.
remainingBlockers.boundedFix: Break or remove the identifiable recurring macro scuff motifs while keeping correctly scaled fine grain and normal orientation. Use distinct source regions or separately authored sparse markings where needed; do not stretch the material or blur all fine surface detail.

remainingBlockers.issue: Door handling wear appears as three similar short dashes beside each handle, with mirrored placement on the Finery leaves. It reads as a small symbol-like pattern rather than accumulated handling.
remainingBlockers.boundedFix: Give each leaf an asymmetric rubbed/chipped zone tied to its actual handle reach and edge, with varied smaller scrapes and a restrained roughness shift. Vary coverage and location between leaves. Keep the bronze placeholder outside this pass.

remainingBlockers.issue: Shutter lip wear is mostly thin straight ochre segments with abrupt ends. The sparse marks are correctly near edges but still look stamped onto otherwise uniform strips.
remainingBlockers.boundedFix: Break the segments into irregular chipped and rubbed edges with varied lengths and discontinuities. Keep stronger wear near working lips, lift handles and lower contact areas; preserve quiet upper paint.

remainingBlockers.issue: The doors have limited visible use history at hinges, kick edges and lower joints after removing the old all-over corrosion.
remainingBlockers.boundedFix: Add restrained local corrosion or dust at the relevant joints and lower edges, with worn paint transitions appropriate to those sites. Do not restore broad orange islands across every panel.

technicalReadbackScope.interpretation: The saved guard reports explicit sRGB decoding for source color and raw numeric channels for source normal/roughness within its tolerance. These checks support the source-data handling, not the rendered art quality or Unity import.
technicalReadbackScope.normalKeyword: Existing material normal keywords were already enabled. No disabled-normal explanation or keyword fix is justified by this review.

mappingLimit: The planned per-leaf composited Lit path and48 duplicated vertices with unchanged triangles are implementation facts, not appearance evidence. Review actual resulting front maps and edge/depth behavior before native acceptance. Verify that the source-preview wear placement is preserved and no side faces receive stretched front projections.
nextGate: Re-render the revised source at the same six views, then inspect the actual composited material result. When repeated motifs and stamped wear are resolved, audition the native doors/shutter under matched noon and afternoon light with the existing graffiti and surrounding architecture.
